none: PAS ESS-288DA5: A Roman copper alloy barbarous radiate of Tetricus I (AD271-274).
contea di ritrovamento: Hertfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy barbarous radiate of Tetricus I (AD271-274). Reece period 13. Obverse shows the bust of Tetricus facing right, wearing a radiate crown and beard. The reverse depicts a stylised female figure, standing left, possibly holding a staff and patera. The inscription reads [---]LVS / M[---] The coin is covered in a mid green patina. The coin is 1.52 grams, 10.37mm diameter
